notes: Foreword: The purpose of this exercise within the ideonomical division "Phenomena" is to check the [validity, efficiency, sufficiency, and power] of the divisional list "208 Major Universally Investigable Dimensions of Scientific Phenomena" in the case of the specific chemical phenomenon 'adsorption'. How good is the list as a whole, and also how do its individual items fare? The photographed sheet is cut off after item 68; items 69–208 are not visible.
